The '''Brig Stompers''' were a group of non-[[Human/Legends|human]] mercenaries active during the [[Galactic War]]. They have gained notoriety after wiping out [[Gaftikar]]'s entire defense force during a coup. By [[3642 BBY]] they were stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where they threatened to overrun the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Thesh Outpost]]. To prevent that from happening, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kavsun]] hired an individual to thin out the Brig Stompers while destroying their supplies.
